checks.name: Tests run only in the x86_64 emulator
Folder selection adds no broad storage or network permission
Folder action uses the system directory picker
Folder picker requests read access without source write access
Actual schema-3 database migrates to schema 4
Schema upgrade preserves existing document bytes and identity
Recursively imports TXT, CSV, PDF and Markdown from multiple nested folders
Malformed CSV, oversized file and unreadable subfolder are reported independently
Unsupported, virtual and repeated provider entries are skipped without looping
Finite cyclic provider graph completes without an artificial partial-success claim
Equal filenames in different subfolders remain separate documents
Full folder provenance is retained in source metadata
Supported hidden files are included
A missing provider file size is handled with streaming limits
Nested PDF remains page-addressable after folder import
Repeating the folder does not duplicate unchanged documents
Single-file and tree URIs identify the same unchanged provider document
A removed document can be imported again without a stale deduplication record
Changed source bytes create a new snapshot and preserve older citations
Empty directory is a successful zero-file import
Cancel keeps completed files and prevents further imports
Selecting the folder again continues safely after cancellation
Settings exposes Add folder
Add folder launches the real picker contract
Picker result imports the complete supported tree through the Activity
Activity presents an English import summary
Last folder report remains accessible from document management

scope: Real Android DocumentsProvider, SQLite and Activity checks on Outpost35; synthetic files; no model execution or physical phone.
